# 设备失效 / Equipment Failure

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/nomads_events_1.txt:16146-16296; events/nomads_events_1.txt:15716-15763 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国执行任一合约期间，合约的月度回调 nomads.6000 每月有2/20机会从随机合约事件池抽取（常见70、稀有25、独特5）；本事件属于稀有池，且只会发生一次（fire_only_once）。

While a nomadic empire runs any contract, the contract's monthly hook nomads.6000 has a 2/20 monthly chance to draw from the contract event pools (common 70, rare 25, unique 5); this event is in the rare pool and happens only once (fire_only_once).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

拥有三个以上模块的方舟舰设备故障，用合金修理、冒险或另寻办法（拾荒者与巨型企业另有选项）。

Equipment fails on an arkship with three or more modules: repair with alloys, take a risk or improvise (Scavengers and megacorps have their own options).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单页事件，选项只带来即时效果，没有后续窗口。

One window; the options only have immediate effects, no follow-up window.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对抽取路径与触发条件。这些合约插曲彼此独立，不合并为一个故事。
  Checked the draw path and trigger. These contract incidents are independent and are not merged into one story.
